title: Conventions catalogue file: one rule table of one profile

group.description: Ruleset a project adopts as a whole (ARCHITECTURE.md header `rulesets:`).

severity.description: error: CI fails. warn: reported, fixed in the same change unless the PR says why. guidance: a judgement call the agent and the reviewer make; never mechanical.

mechanism.description: What enforces the rule. agent: the conventions skill and the reviewer (severity guidance only).

tool.description: The rule, check or job that enforces it: an ESLint rule id, an ast-grep rule id, a `conventions check` id, a CI job name.

checklist.description: guidance rules that go on the PR checklist.

reportedAs.description: The lint message carries this other rule's id (one tool enforces both). Fixture coverage is checked under that id.
